# Nika Appliance Repair

> On-site appliance repair in Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area.
> Phone: (437) 524-1053. Website: https://nikaappliancerepair.com/
> Booking: https://nikaappliancerepair.com/book

## About
Nika Appliance Repair provides on-site appliance repair. Share the appliance model, symptoms and service address when calling or booking. Availability and the repair scope should be confirmed for the request. This guide does not establish a business address, exact review rating, repair price or guaranteed appointment time.
